obligations.source_text: Create a photorealistic mainstream swimwear campaign featuring a clearly adult original K-pop-idol-inspired woman in her mid-twenties with a distinct fictional face. The casting remains an original adult fashion model. She has luminous porcelain-pale skin, long glossy dark hair, and a slender athletic silhouette. She wears a sleek one-piece swimsuit in opaque matte fabric. The swimsuit is deep navy blue with supportive wide straps and a full-coverage cut. At a bright ocean waterline, she stands barefoot in a three-quarter rear view, her torso angled about 45 degrees away from the camera as she looks toward the horizon. Use a balanced vertical full-figure frame from a restrained low camera position behind and slightly to one side. Her feet remain close and knees softly aligned while a narrow background opening remains visible between the actual upper inner-thigh contours, preserving a readable thigh gap with believable anatomy. Warm late-afternoon sunlight traces her hair, shoulders, and legs; gentle surf, pale sand, and a clean horizon create polished contemporary K-pop editorial styling. Keep the mood confident and calm, with authentic skin and fabric texture.
